boundary: Every case is a synthetic challenge run against the simulated Seren CLI and channel. A passing evaluation shows harness behavior only; it is not evidence about the Seren service, and the case set is too small for statistical or general-effectiveness claims.
verdict_rule: accept: the run completed cleanly (journey passed, shutdown confirmed, no unknown mutation). inconclusive: the journey was blocked or not run, with no failed step. reject: anything else, including a passed journey whose shutdown is unconfirmed.

baseline.name: start/health-only
baseline.definition: accept when the start command answered with acceptance and the first observed top-level health status is ok; otherwise reject. It checks nothing else (no readiness, reply, shutdown or recovery).

cases.title: Valid reply to the current probe
cases.rationale: The employee answering this probe, with confirmed shutdown, is the customer acceptance condition.
cases.source: implementation plan (not in this release) operational steps 4-6; pilot notes (not in this release) acceptance

cases.title: Healthy status with connector failure
cases.rationale: Start accepted and health ok while connector dispatch fails must not pass.
cases.source: serenorg/seren issue #232 (incident pattern); implementation plan (not in this release) stage 3 acceptance

cases.title: Old, unrelated or wrong-author reply
cases.rationale: A message not from the employee, or not bound to this probe, is not an answer.
cases.source: implementation plan (not in this release) operational step 5: old or unrelated messages cannot pass

cases.title: Missing reader access
cases.rationale: Without channel read access the reply cannot be observed; that is a blocked observation, not proof of an employee defect.
cases.source: implementation plan (not in this release) stage 3 acceptance: inaccessible Discord is blocked

cases.title: Ambiguous start outcome
cases.rationale: An unanswered start is reconciled by reading state, never retried blindly; here it applied, so the journey continues.
cases.source: implementation plan (not in this release) result and recovery contract: inspect state before retrying

cases.title: Unconfirmed shutdown
cases.rationale: A journey that passed but whose shutdown is unconfirmed must not be reported as a clean completion.
cases.source: implementation plan (not in this release): failed or unconfirmed shutdown is visible
cases.baseline_not_applicable_reason: The baseline does not observe shutdown.
